parameters.content:
Master Documentation: Smart B2B Hardware Catalog Exporter

📌 Project Overview
An automated end-to-end PDF generation, multi-channel distribution, and archiving system built on n8n. It allows users to query live inventory via Webhook triggers, normalize singular/plural search queries, generate dynamic AI summary briefs, compile structured HTML templates, convert them into high-quality PDF binaries using PDFShift, and deliver assets via Gmail, direct Webhook response, and Google Drive.

🛠️ System Architecture & Node Pipeline

🌐 Node 1: Webhook Search Trigger

Type: Entry Point (POST)

Function: Public API endpoint (/search-catalog) receiving query JSON body parameters (keyword).

📊 Node 2: Fetch Google Sheet Data

Type: Data Fetching

Function: Pulls full live inventory records (Product Name, Category, Price) from target Google Sheet.

⚙️ Node 3: Code in JavaScript (Keyword Parsing)

Type: Business Logic & Sanitization

Function: Extracts searchKeyword, trims extra trailing spaces, and normalizes strings to prevent downstream filter breakages.

🧠 Node 4: Message a Model (AI Executive Summary)

Type: AI / LLM Node

Function: Generates a dynamic 2-sentence executive summary emphasizing durability and compliance tailored to the search keyword.

🎨 Node 5: General HTML (Template Builder)

Type: Template Engine & Fuzzy Matcher

Function: Filters sheet inventory using regex-based singular/plural logic (replace(/s$/, '')), builds HTML table rows, and returns strict <!DOCTYPE html> layout.

⚡ Node 6: Code in JavaScript (PDF Generator)

Type: Binary Conversion Engine

Function: Dispatches clean HTML to PDFShift API using native this.helpers.httpRequest and converts array buffer into a Base64 PDF binary (catalog.pdf).

📤 Node 7: Send a Message - Gmail

Type: Email Delivery

Function: Attaches generated PDF binary stream and emails it to client stakeholders.

☁️ Node 8: Google Drive Upload

Type: Cloud Archival

Function: Saves a backup copy of the PDF catalog to a designated Google Drive repository.

📥 Node 9: Respond to Webhook

Type: HTTP Response

Function: Serves binary stream directly back to original client request for immediate browser download.

⚙️ How to Setup & Authenticate

Webhook Trigger: Set HTTP Method to POST, Path to search-catalog, and Response Mode to On Received.

Google Sheets Node: Authenticate Google OAuth2 and pick target Inventory Spreadsheet ID and Sheet Tab.

AI Summary Node: Connect OpenAI credential and pass ={{ $json.searchKeyword }} in prompt parameter.

PDF Generator Node: Configure API Authorization header with key sk_b11b272b864770bf0cc97994d4b7009be9faa9ec.

Gmail / Drive Nodes: Bind Binary Property Name to data for correct file attachment and sync.

🚀 How to Run & Execute

Public Webhook Request Format (POST Payload)

Endpoint: http://localhost:5678/webhook/search-catalog

JSON Body:

JSON
{
  "keyword": "Measuring Tape"
}

parameters.content:
[Node 1] Incoming Search Trigger
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Captures incoming HTTP POST requests containing search parameters from client applications or webhooks.

Configuration & Rules:
• HTTP Method: POST
• Path: /search-catalog
• Response Mode: On Received (Immediate 200 OK)

Data Handling:
• Expects JSON body payload format: {"keyword": "Measuring Tape"}
• Passes the raw string payload down the pipeline for sanitization.

[Node 2] Live Inventory Retrieval
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Fetches full inventory dataset from Google Sheets to perform client-side filtering.

Configuration & Rules:
• Resource: Document
• Operation: Read
• Document: Select target B2B Inventory Spreadsheet

Data Output:
• Returns structured JSON objects containing columns:
  - Product Name
  - Category
  - Price / SKU / Specifications

[Node 3] Search Query Sanitizer
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Normalizes search strings to prevent logic breakages in downstream filter checks.

Logic & Features:
• Extracts body.keyword safely with fallback defaults.
• Strips leading, trailing, and redundant spacing.
• Standardizes string casing for uniform matching.

Output:
• Outputs clean string: $json.searchKeyword

[Node 4] AI Executive Brief Generator
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Generates dynamic narrative content tailored to the specific search query for the PDF header.

Prompt Specs:
• Context: B2B Industrial Hardware Catalog
• Instruction: Write a concise 2-sentence executive summary emphasizing product durability, technical compliance, and inventory scalability.

[Node 5] Dynamic HTML Engine & Fuzzy Matcher
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Filters dataset using regex-based plural logic and compiles HTML table syntax.

Core Logic:
• Fuzzy Plural Handling: Applies .replace(/s$/, '') to equate "Tape" and "Tapes".
• Table Compilation: Dynamically iterates through matched items to build <tr> rows.
• Output Strictness: Enforces exact <!DOCTYPE html> start with 0 leading whitespace to meet PDFShift validation standards.

[Node 6] PDFShift Conversion Engine
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Dispatches raw HTML to PDFShift API via native execution helpers, bypassing external module limits.

Execution Protocol:
• Uses: this.helpers.httpRequest
• Headers: Basic Auth with base64 API key encoding
• Payload: JSON stringified { source: cleanHtml }
• Binary Output: ArrayBuffer converted to Base64 PDF stream (catalog.pdf)

[Node 7] Email PDF Delivery (Gmail)
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Automates direct delivery of the compiled PDF catalog to client or stakeholder email addresses.

Configuration & Rules:
• Resource: Message
• Operation: Send
• Attachments: Binary Data -> 'catalog.pdf'

Email Payload:
• Subject: Dynamic search catalog for $json.searchKeyword
• Body: Includes executive summary and downloadable catalog PDF attached directly.

[Node 8] Cloud Storage Backup (Google Drive)
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Uploads generated PDF catalogs to a centralized company cloud directory for archival and audit tracking.

Configuration & Rules:
• Resource: File
• Operation: Upload
• Target Folder: Select 'B2B Generated Catalogs' directory

File Settings:
• Binary Property: data
• File Name: Dynamic catalog naming (e.g., Catalog_MeasuringTape_2026.pdf)mponents/sticky-notes/)

[Node 9] Direct Webhook Response
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: 
Returns the generated PDF binary stream directly back to the original client request for instant browser download.

Configuration & Rules:
• Respond With: Binary File
• Response Data: Property 'data'

Behavior:
• Serves PDF directly to front-end UI or client application with proper Content-Type headers (application/pdf).
